title: Canadian and non-U.S. Epoch connection-source framework
note: The current 93-site Epoch snapshot contains no Canada records. Canadian connection sources are nevertheless maintained as a ready-to-use layer and now include current 2026 public intake/planning context.

sources.matching_rule: Use only when the individual application/site/customer is publicly identifiable; aggregate application MW is not a facility match.
Resolve the exact proponent, location, connection point/project identifier and status where public.
Use as grid context; do not treat capacity layers as proof of a specific facility-service match.
Resolve named site/project and individual selection/connection evidence before asserting a site match.

non_us_rules: Identify the national transmission operator and local distribution network.
Prefer exact service applications, grid-connection agreements, planning approvals or regulator dockets over sector aggregates.
Preserve local-language identifiers and raw project names alongside normalized English names.
Record NO MATCH FOUND where site identity is public but no individual connection record is public.

current_public_context.public_context: 15 Emerging Industries applications representing close to 800 MW of requested load; feasibility results were scheduled for August 24, 2026 with successful applicants anticipated by end-September 2026.
current_public_context.accounting: Aggregate intake context only; applications are not automatically mapped to individual data centers.

current_public_context.public_context: Public Application Status provides a large connection universe; the September 2026 source exposes 2,074 application rows. Large-computational-load technical requirements were revised September 3, 2026.
current_public_context.accounting: Application-level records may be confidential at later study stages; exact site matching must use public identifiers.

current_public_context.public_context: Hydro-Québec publicly describes a fast-growing data-center sector; its rate proposal discusses an electricity sector peak near 200 MW currently and a potential increase toward roughly 1,000 MW by 2035.
current_public_context.accounting: Sector aggregate only; not a facility-level match.

current_public_context.public_context: Requests above 5 MW require legal entity, site location, construction start, operation schedule, peak MW, annual GWh and related project information under the published large-supply process.
current_public_context.accounting: Connection-process requirements; no customer-level data-center universe is asserted.

current_public_context.public_context: Vaughan MTS No. 6 planning documents describe a proposed 230 kV station with 170 MVA capacity supporting an undisclosed customer's proposed 108 MVA data-center facility.
current_public_context.accounting: Named/discrete connection project evidence, but customer identity is not public in the cited source.
